indicators.text: IODA BGP reachable prefixes or active-probing responsiveness drops >=25% below the 7-day rolling baseline for >=30 minutes.
Two or more countries sharing a submarine cable corridor experience concurrent BGP/probing drops >=20% within a 2-hour window.
OONI measurement aggregation shows confirmed blocking or anomaly rate >=15% across >=50 daily measurements in a country.
Single-probe or darknet-only drop with stable BGP prefix count and normal OONI reachability.
Cross-program tip: Elements seismic/volcanic alert or Wake vessel loitering anomaly within 50 km of a submarine cable corridor.

warning_problems.title: State-directed internet shutdown or curfews
warning_problems.watch_condition: National or mobile ASN BGP/probing drop >=25% or OONI anomaly surge >=15% during unrest, elections, or military operations.
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a warning item when BGP/probing drop crosses 40% or when OONI blocking + IODA routing drop co-occur.
warning_problems.deactivation: BGP visibility and active probing return within 10% of the 7-day baseline for 24 hours.

hypotheses.title: Deliberate state-ordered connectivity curfew or ASN shutdown
Physical power-grid failure or kinetic strike on telecom exchanges
Measurement artefact or upstream transit reroute without user blackout

warning_problems.title: Submarine cable cut or landing-station disruption
warning_problems.watch_condition: Concurrent connectivity degradation in two or more countries served by the same submarine cable corridor.
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a warning item when >=2 corridor countries drop >=20% or when an outage co-occurs with an Elements seismic event or Wake maritime anomaly.
warning_problems.deactivation: Traffic reroutes restore >90% baseline connectivity or cable repair completes.

hypotheses.title: Physical submarine cable fault (anchor drag, trawler, or seabed slide)
Coordinated domestic throttling across neighbouring states
Upstream Tier-1 transit peering dispute or collector artefact
